changes.comment: A synced folder now uses one relay connection for all of its notes instead of one per note, so a vault of more than a couple of hundred notes can sync in a browser at all.

A first sync of a whole vault reports its progress in two phases — notes arriving from the relay, then files being written to disk — so a device being linked can show a real count instead of a spinner.
A relay that goes quiet during a first sync is now reported after twenty seconds of silence rather than waited on for a minute, and a sync that is still arriving is never cut off.
A note that starts syncing after its folder is already connected no longer shows as offline while it is plainly in sync.
